  * Document legacy/unused audio preview styles

- Remove empty js/modals/ directory

Impact:
- modal.js: 2,800 → 1,737 lines (38% reduction)
- characterModel.js: 27 → 10 lines (63% reduction)
- All JavaScript syntax validated
- No breaking changes - all active features preserved
